name: Salon G and Spa
website: https://mysalongandspa.com/ (listed on Google, currently broken) and https://hairbarnyc.com/ (also listed on Google, but it is a New York/Florida chain with no New Jersey location)
what_they_do: Hair salon and day spa on US-130, listed on Google as a hair salon with a 'Book online' action and with women-owned and Latino-owned attributes. Its own web presence is broken, so the specific service menu and prices are not published anywhere I could read.
customers: Route 130 shoppers and North Brunswick residents, appointment and walk-in clients; closed Mondays, open Tue-Sat.

size_signals.signal: 4.7 from 117 Google reviews (the Maps page itself displayed 4.5 - listing data not consolidated)
Google listing carries a 'Book online' button, self-identified women-owned and Latino-owned attributes

listing.rating: 4.5 on the Maps page; 4.7 per Birdeye's Google-review mirror

website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Google's 'Book online' action only; the salon's own site cannot be reached
website_review.trust_signals: 117 Google reviews and listing attributes only - no site to show work, staff or credentials
website_review.out_of_date_signs: mysalongandspa.com fails TLS (certificate verify error) and in the browser redirects to an ad network page (cf.smooth-web.site), i.e. the domain appears hijacked or parked; hairbarnyc.com, the second site on the listing, is a different business
website_review.search_basics: no working site, so no titles, descriptions, service pages or schema; the Google listing sends visitors to a broken domain and to an out-of-state chain
top_issues: Both websites on the Google listing are wrong: one fails its certificate and redirects to an ad page, the other belongs to a NY/Florida chain that has no New Jersey location
No services, prices or hours anywhere online despite 117 reviews
Rating is inconsistent across listings (4.5 vs 4.7) and there is no site to be the source of truth

agent_readiness.notes: Findable 1: GBP exists with hours, phone and booking action, but both website fields are wrong, which actively misroutes customers and crawlers. Answerable 0: no readable page states services, prices or service area. Bookable 1: Google offers a Book online action (destination not confirmed) but nothing on the business's own web presence can take a request.

operations_signals.signal: Google's 'Book online' button is the only digital booking route; the salon's own site is unreachable
Two conflicting websites attached to the listing suggest nobody is maintaining the digital footprint day to day

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the listing links first: remove hairbarnyc.com (wrong company) and the dead mysalongandspa.com, and point the profile at one working https page
top_opportunities.evidence: mysalongandspa.com throws an SSL error then redirects to an ad page; hairbarnyc.com lists only NY and Florida salons

top_opportunities.opportunity: Build a simple one-page site (or repair the domain) with the service menu, price ranges, hours, click-to-call and an embedded booking widget
top_opportunities.evidence: No readable page about the salon exists; services and prices are unavailable to customers and agents

top_opportunities.opportunity: Consolidate booking and reminders on one platform (Vagaro/Booksy/Square) and reconcile the rating/hours data across Google and directories
top_opportunities.evidence: Only Google's Book online action exists and ratings differ between Maps and review mirrors

scores.reasons: Gap 5 - web presence is broken and mislinked, and no service or price information exists online. Ability to pay 3 - 117 reviews and a spa/hair mix, single location. Ease 4 - link cleanup is an hour, a one-pager a few days. Evidence 4 - both domains tested and Google listing read directly, though the booking destination was not identified.
